title: Employee work areas and work stations.
officialText:
Spaces and elements within employee work areas shall comply with
Sections 907.5.2.3.2, 1007 and 1104.3.1 and shall be designed and constructed so that individuals with disabilities can approach,
enter and exit the work area. In addition, at least one and not less than five percent of seating, tables and/or work stations, if
provided, within employee work areas shall comply with applicable sections of ICC A117.1.
